web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's official Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for August 2026 was released on Monday, showing a slight improvement in manufacturing activity. The PMI rose to 49.8 from 49.2 in July, indicating that while factory activity remains in contraction territory, it has shown a marginal recovery. The consensus among economists had predicted a reading of 49.6.
